proposed_facts.reason: Canonical drop setup assigns xDD8 zero, unlike randomized bounce setup. State-1 animation snapshots position, adds spin, and delegates countdown; physics enforces the configured speeds, and qualifying terrain contact selects state 4. The correction agrees with the functionality document and preserves the supported Drop name.

State 1 is selected at line 190 before velocity reset at 193 and drop setup at 195. Its physics assigns horizontal velocity, adds negative acceleration, clamps to the negative terminal value, and performs no state transition.

Initial fired setup selects state 0. Fired and dropped terrain responses and randomized combat responses enter state 4; state-4 collision selects state 2 on qualifying contact. The post-impact bounce mapping is supported without assigning an unsupported meaning to state 3.

The complete reflection callback reverses facing, mirrors the XY reference through current position, updates model orientation and XY velocity, assigns xD48_halfLifeTimer to xD44_lifeTimer, and returns false without selecting a state. The independently read shared countdown decrements the active timer, so the assignment is not necessarily a shortening.

The initializer's owner assignment, common setup, state selection, subsequent common/lifetime setup, velocity reset, and drop-parameter installation appear in the stated order. The animation, physics, and collision consumers support the remaining behavior.
